synopsis: As we all know, you can level up by killing monsters, and I am... that monster. As the only zombie on earth that can turn around and not die, I concealed my identity and kept a low profile as a zombie in order to protect myself. However, I was worried about my sick ex-girlfriend, so I secretly protected her. I didn't expect that my ex-girlfriend had become a female warrior who killed zombies without blinking an eye, and I was discovered by her? I wanted to escape, she wanted to chase me, we struggled and fell in love, and in the end you told me that the whole world had to die? Okay, I won't pretend anymore, I am actually a vaccine. title: Bing Ruo Meimei Zong Shi Xiao Xiang Wo
titleRomaji: Bing Ruo Meimei Zong Shi Xiao Xiang Wo
synonyms: My Sickly Sister Always Misses Me
synopsis: Xu Yulian is the eldest daughter of a wealthy family, smart and beautiful. Her life should've been a smooth ride, until she ran into a stumbling block named "Xu Wenjiao." Her sister came out of nowhere and became the person she hates the most. When she was a child, the frail Xu Wenjiao occupied all of her mother's time and attention. After she grew up, Xu Yulian had a crush on the neighbor girl who had just returned from studying abroad. But before she could get up the courage, she saw the girl confess to Xu Wenjiao instead. In this house, it's going to be either her or Xu Wenjiao, one or the other. Xu Yulian got so angry that she actually packed her bags to leave home, but her sister, who always seemed so weak and frail, suddenly grabbed her by the wrist wrist and pushed her into the corner. Xu Wenjiao looked at her jealously and whispered in her ear: "Sister, why do you like her but not me?" Xu Yulian blushed, "Xu Wenjiao, are you crazy? Have you been reading too many bad romance novels to be acting this way?" (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Pan wo Nameru na!
synopsis: No education, no work experience, no friends. Muyu Uchiki, a 19-year-old girl who has been a shut-in for two years, was living a self-defeating life day after day, But then a turning point finally comes her way. Her aunt, who lives in Kamakura, invites Muyu to help out at her bakery. She refuses the unexpected request at first. However, her mother is eager to get her out of the house (by bribing her with money), and she reluctantly agrees to go... Yumu arrives in Kamakura with no idea what to expect, until her aunt delivers a shocking message...! Set in a bakery in Kamakura, a heartwarming comedy about a girl's daily struggles! (Source: Ura Sunday, translated)

title: Akuyaku Reijou-tachi wa Yuruganai
titleNative: 悪役令嬢たちは揺るがない
synopsis: It has been half a year since Aini Mikkola, the saintess in training who who hails from a barony in the countryside, arrived at the Royal Academy. The school is in turmoil. The boys, the sons of aristocrats, are at the mercy of Aini's innocent, natural cuteness, while the girls are angry at her disregard for the manners of the aristocracy. In the midst of all this, there were three daughters who were dubbed "the villainesses," in reference to a popular story. Seraphina, the crown prince's fiancée and the daughter of an upright marquise. Sandra, the noble daughter of a viscount who made their wealth from commerce. Bernardetta, the brilliant daughter of the current Prime Minister's who is a marquise. When a sense of disquiet begins to grow in the school, these women finally stand up! To correct Aini's mistakes and to follow their own hearts. This is a record of the battle between the three "villainesses" and the saintly apprentices, a battle for the way of life of women. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
